description.value: Cambo Beach is a family-run international fusion restaurant on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Penticton, operated by the Tran Family since 2012. The menu draws on Vietnamese roots and global culinary influences, with each dish described as a story of 'journeys and discoveries.' Cyclists along West Lakeshore Drive will find it a lakeside stop with outdoor seating and a view of the 135-km lake.
